name: RELAYS / SOLID RELAYS
text:
Relays and solid relays, as well as related products such as thermal coolers and thermal silicon crease are parts of the electrical system used to control electrical appliances.
Low-current and high-current requiring appliances such as lights.
Relays and solid relays in different in that solid relays are automated, and quieter, whilst relays emit a clicking sound, you know from on and off switches you hear when turning lights on and off.
Whether you need an additional relay or a replacement, you can find one here.

We’re looking forward to helping fixing your sauna or helping your upgrade it.
text_short:
In this category you may find relays/solid relays and related products, like thermal coolers, thermal silicone grease, etc.
Solid relays are devices that turn on or off the power supplied to other devices. Generally, the relay operates as a physical switch. Relay is mechanical. Solid relay is fully automated and does not require human interaction, as it switches electronically. Relays/solid relays are used to control the appliances with low-current signals and high-current infrared sauna devices such as lights, chromotherapy panels, etc.
